create_sharedcount: create a SharedCount instance to track a shared epoch counter across multiprocessing workers
create_loaderbundle: create a LoaderBundle wrapping a DataLoader with optional DistributedSampler and shared interval counter
set_loaderbundle_interval: set the interval on a LoaderBundle to update its sampler epoch and shared counter
create_shardspec: create a ShardSpec with URLs and optional weights and sizes that validates shard counts
create_imagefeatureinfo: create an ImageFeatureInfo dataclass to describe image feature output name, input keys, and color mode
